people.name: Jerusalem
people.line: The capital of Israel, a holy city for three religions

translations.web: He had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
translations.bsb: and kept vast supplies in the cities of Judah. He also had warriors in Jerusalem who were mighty men of valor.
translations.kjv: And he had much business in the cities of Judah: and the men of war, mighty men of valour, were in Jerusalem.
translations.asv: And he had many works in the cities of Judah; and men of war, mighty men of valor, in Jerusalem.
